effective.basis: Champion Pack: Game Two printing CP02-EN010

transitions.historical_text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Contract with the Dark Master". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand. During your turn, you can roll 1 six-sided die. If the result is 1 or 2, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If the result is 3, 4, or 5, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. If the result is 6, destroy all monsters on your side of the field.
transitions.modern_text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Contract with the Dark Master". During your Main Phase, you can roll 1 six-sided die. On a 1 or 2, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. On a 3, 4, or 5, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. On a 6, destroy all monsters on your side of the field.
transitions.summary: Wording only: the redundant Ritual tribute sentence ('You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand') is dropped, since the Ritual Spell already dictates the tribute, and 'During your turn, you can roll 1 six-sided die' becomes 'During your Main Phase, you can roll 1 six-sided die', which restates the Main-Phase-only timing an Ignition Effect already has. The die outcomes are untouched.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (LCYW-EN123, Legendary Collection 3: Yugi's World Mega Pack)

transitions.historical_text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Contract with the Dark Master". During your Main Phase, you can roll 1 six-sided die. On a 1 or 2, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. On a 3, 4, or 5, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. On a 6, destroy all monsters on your side of the field.
transitions.modern_text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Contract with the Dark Master". Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, then destroy all monsters your opponent controls if you roll 1 or 2, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls if you roll 3, 4 or 5, or destroy all monsters you control if you roll 6.
transitions.summary: Functional erratum: LCYW-EN123 puts 'Once per turn:' in front of the die roll. No earlier printing limits how often the effect may be used - 'During your Main Phase, you can roll 1 six-sided die' caps the roll at one die per activation, not one activation per turn - so the period card can roll repeatedly in a Main Phase, re-rolling after a 3/4/5 single destruction or risking further 6s, while the errata'd card gets exactly one roll per turn.

coverage.gap_reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode

gap.behavioural_impact: In GOAT and Edison a resolved Dark Master - Zorc can roll its die as many times as its controller dares in a Main Phase, so a single Zorc can keep rolling until it clears the opponent's field (or wipes its own); the shipped card stops after one roll per turn.

review.notes: upstream_implementations is empty. Chain starts at v1 (DR1-EN244, 2005-03-19), the text in force at the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot - Dark Revelation Volume 1 landed thirteen days before it. Pre-baseline v0 (DCR-082, 2003-12-01) differs only in the 'offer as a Tribute'/'Level Stars' phrasing of the same Ritual clause. The Edison snapshot (2010-04-24) falls after CP02-EN010 (2007-02-06), so Edison uses v2 and GOAT uses v1; both precede the 2012-09-29 erratum, so both need the unlimited-roll behaviour. On the cosmetic call for 'During your turn' -> 'During your Main Phase': an Ignition Effect is restricted to the controller's Main Phase by the game rules whatever the card says, so the reprint narrows the printed wording without narrowing the legal window - it is recorded cosmetic for that reason, and no separate implementation is needed between GOAT and Edison. No entry for this card in edison-functional-errata.md.
